faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Kannur University Telephone Operator recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Kannur University Telephone Operator recruitment is 16th August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Telephone Operator post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Telephone Operator post in Kannur University.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Telephone Operator post?
faq.answer: The required educational qualification includes ITI/Diploma/Degree, education in Telecommunication, and an Internet/Email Certificate.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Telephone Operator position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Telephone Operator position is 50 years as of 01.01.2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Telephone Operator post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 16,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the experience required for the Telephone Operator post?
faq.answer: A minimum of five years of experience in EPBX and FAX maintenance and operation is required.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is online.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for this position is contract-based.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification and the apply online link in the "Important Links" section of this article.
